# /vendor — Vendor marketplace management and third-party provider onboarding

Vendor marketplace management and third-party provider onboarding.

## Usage

```bash
// turbo
mekong vendor $ARGUMENTS
```

## Subcommands

| Subcommand | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| `onboard` | Register and onboard a new vendor into the marketplace. |
| `list` | List registered vendors with optional type and status filtering. |
| `delist` | Remove or sandbox a vendor from the marketplace. |
| `audit` | Perform automated compliance, security, and boundary assessment on a vendor. |
